findings.message: End-of-life date 2027-04-16 extends ~6 months forward, exceeding the 3-month cap. No accepted support plan is documented. Application (demo-app 1.2.0) is staged from Ubuntu archive, not upstream-sourced. Reduce EOL to comply or provide an accepted support plan.

Package repository `canonical-demo/stable` PPA added without specified provenance. No apt candidate/origin report supplied. Clarify which packages, if any, will be selected from the PPA vs. the Ubuntu archive.

summary: Source revision bump with EOL extension and PPA addition. Recipe changes are limited to adding a package repository; parts and services are retained. Deb-security-manifest requirement met. EOL extension exceeds policy cap without support plan; PPA provenance unspecified.
